PLAN "12-Week Strength Programme for Stage III Endometriosis (Phased Around Cycle and Flares)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build total body strength with cycle and flare adaptation"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Familiarisation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m

NOTES
  - On flow days (first 4 days of each 27-day cycle, e.g. 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-04, 2026-06-28 to 2026-07-01, 2026-07-25 to 2026-07-28) and on flare days (2026-07-10 to 2026-07-13, 2026-08-04 to 2026-08-07): 
    - No HIIT, no jumping, no heavy Valsalva (keep RPE ≤ 7, use moderate loads, avoid maximal bracing).
    - If session falls on these days, reduce RPE by 1, reduce rest by 15 seconds, and substitute any exercise that feels uncomfortable with a machine or bodyweight alternative.
    - If discomfort is high, substitute main lifts with: leg_press, chest_fly, cable_row, lat_pulldown, plank, bird_dog, side_plank, walking, cycling, or stretching as tolerated.
  - Outside these windows, follow the main prescription as written.
  - If a session falls on a flare or flow day, trainer may swap with a rest day or move to later in the week as needed.
